name: Subscription RBAC Elevation
description: Azure subscriptions have their own roles: Owner, Contributor, User Access Administrator. Those roles can create resources, change networking, and grant more roles. An attacker who promotes a principal at subscription scope can run the cloud bill and the workloads without being Global Admin in Entra. Watch for Owner/Contributor grants, especially from a new source IP or a new service principal. Subscription Owner is as serious as a domain admin for that bill.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
